string-array.name: banter_go
string-array.item: Let\'s go. I\'m with you on the roofs.
Start jumping. I\'ve got your back.

string-array.name: banter_chapter
string-array.item: New rooftops ahead. Watch your step.

string-array.name: banter_combo
string-array.item: Good rhythm. Don\'t rush the next jump.

string-array.name: banter_gold
string-array.item: You caught a gold sun. Well done.

string-array.name: banter_hurt
string-array.item: Careful. You still have hearts left.
That hit hurt. Jump a little earlier.

string-array.name: banter_dead
string-array.item: That\'s okay. We can run it again.
We fell. Take a breath, then retry.

string-array.name: banter_grind
string-array.item: Nice grind on the wire. Keep balanced.

string-array.name: banter_shield
string-array.item: Shield is on. You can take one hit.

resources.string: Solar district. Glass canopies crack, keep moving.
Storm line. Watch the cables and the wind.
Night city. Follow the window lights.
High roofs now. Every gap counts.
